objective: Screen the already frozen orientation-class spatial detector against a new public actual-hydrogen open-channel release dataset without fitting coordinates, source strength, alarm thresholds or rank coefficients.
claim_boundary: This is a component spatial-ranking holdout only. It does not validate HRS outdoor detector placement, concentration amplitudes, alarm/trip setpoints, CFD, ESD effectiveness, consequence distance or a station-to-vehicle loop.

source.title: Experimental Data of Hydrogen Dispersion in an Open-ended Rectangular Channel

required_fields: sensor positions in the same coordinate frame
filling pressure and temporal mass-flow context
eligibility.independence_rule: No experiment may be used for model development, coordinate selection, amplitude calibration or alarm threshold selection before this protocol is frozen.
eligibility.failure_rule: If source/sensor coordinates or per-sensor numeric concentration traces are unavailable, retain the dataset as context-only and do not execute a spatial score.
eligibility.raw_file_policy: Raw archives remain outside the repository; only hashes, metadata and derived aggregate results may be committed.

evaluation_contract.response_window: Frozen release marker onward; no manual crop or time shift.
evaluation_contract.per_sensor_response: q99(concentration) minus q10(concentration), with at least 30 finite samples.
primary_endpoints: Spearman rank correlation between frozen geometry score and robust sensor response
top-five predictor recall of observed top response quartile
nearest-predicted sensor in observed top response quartile
evaluation_contract.promotion_rule: Every eligible experiment and every aggregate screen must pass; otherwise retain the negative result and keep runtime routing unchanged.
